run_evaluator_cli: run the scaling law evaluator on a Python script by passing its path as a CLI argument
evaluate_scaling_law_program: evaluate a scaling law program by fitting on training data and testing on held-out data
calculate_final_metrics: calculate NMSE, NMAE, and R-squared metrics from prediction and ground truth numpy arrays
run_with_timeout: run a function with a configurable timeout using a thread pool executor
resolve_task_name: resolve a scaling law task name from environment variables or a program file path
